in_sanskrit.name: सकेत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is full of grace, a companion, a witness

in_marathi.name: Saket
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saket हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saket is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saketas' which means 'belonging to the forest deity'. In Hindu mythology, Saket is the name of a divine forest where Lord Rama spent some time during his exile. It is a popular name among Hindus, especially in India, and is often given to boys.
